description: Descriptive sample-level QC within explicitly declared batches. Each included subject contributes at most one sample per batch; subjects may recur across batches, so batch summaries are not independent. Modified z = 0.6745 * (transformed value - median) / raw MAD, including the observation in its reference batch. Absolute scores strictly above the declared threshold are review flags, not p-values, calibrated error rates, bad-sample diagnoses or biological effects. Small groups and zero MAD remain unscored, with no epsilon or pooled-batch fallback. Positive abundance and retained-row metrics use log10 without pseudocounts; fractions use their original scale. Missing values are unavailable, not zero. Most observations in each batch must form a meaningful reference: systematic batch failure, heterogeneity, biological confounding and masking can evade or distort flags. Inspect the common-scale distributions and exclusions. No sample is removed and no batch correction or causal inference is performed. Dataset Artificial batch-QC study · 26 observations (d-b62413eece36e225); QC: none; abundance unit UMIs; single cell: false. Bulk fractions use counts; single-cell fractions use contigs. Included 24 samples / 24 unique subjects; excluded 2. Threshold: absolute modified z > 3.5; minimum evaluable subjects per batch/metric 5. Median and MAD use the displayed transformed scale.
